# Modules and Packages

A **module** is a `.py` file. A **package** is a directory of modules. `import` binds names; `uv` / `pyproject.toml` is how third-party modules arrive.

## Planned chapters

| Chapter | Focus |
|---------|--------|
| Import and `sys.path` | What `import util` searches |
| Packages and `__init__` | Layout, relative imports |
| `uv` add / lock / sync | Dependencies as a file, not a snowflake machine |
| Scripts vs packages | `__main__.py`, entry points |
| Publishing (later) | Build a wheel when you need one |

Until these leaves exist: follow [Project layout](../01-getting-started/06-project-layout.qmd) and the official [modules](https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/modules.html) + [venv](https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/venv.html) tutorial chapters.
